name: Kurihara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kurihara city emblem in white: a stylised leaf within curved strokes forming a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kurihara, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 September 2005.

features.role: Kurihara city emblem — a stylised leaf within curved strokes forming a ring
